editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the MAC Master Addictions Counselor Certification by NAADAC and NCC AP. Review domains, passing score, question count, and duration.
editorial.overview: The MAC Master Addictions Counselor Certification is administered jointly by NAADAC and NCC AP. It evaluates professional competencies across five core counseling domains, assessing varied knowledge in treatment orientation, assessment, ongoing planning, counseling practices, and professional standards to validate advanced addiction counseling expertise for qualified healthcare and clinical practitioners across the healthcare sector.
editorial.who_should_take: Experienced substance use disorder and addiction counseling professionals seeking formal master-level validation of their clinical knowledge, treatment planning abilities, and professional practices through NAADAC / NCC AP.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review each of the five exam domains in great detail to ensure complete understanding of all required subjects and clinical guidelines. Study advanced counseling approaches, client assessment methods, ongoing treatment planning protocols, and professional ethics standards carefully. Practice answering clinical scenario questions aligned with official NAADAC guidelines to ensure success.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Arrive early for your 180-minute testing session. Pace yourself carefully across all 150 questions to ensure you can complete every domain within the allocated time.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The official certification exam consists of 150 total questions covering five distinct domains related to addiction counseling, treatment planning, client assessment, and professional standards for all candidates.
The official passing score for the examination is set at 75%, which requires candidates to successfully answer 112 out of the 150 total questions correctly.
The total duration of the test is exactly 180 minutes, providing candidates with three full hours to complete all items under standard testing conditions without feeling rushed.
The professional certification is administered jointly by NAADAC and the NCC AP. Check with NAADAC / NCC AP for the current certification path and registration details.
